noAccess.title: Campaigns
noAccess.body: Campaigns needs the right to see campaigns. Ask an administrator for it.
noAccess.moduleOff: The campaigns module is switched off (Settings › Modules).

hold.not_connected_email: the email provider is not connected — it leaves once one is
hold.sender_domain: the sender domain is not verified by the email provider
hold.audience: nobody in the audience can receive it now

list.created: Draft created · opened in the email builder
list.viaUtm: Signups and MRR won via UTM: last touch with the campaign’s utm_campaign after sending started
list.noWorkflow: Workflow step · not used by a workflow yet

card.pick: Pick a campaign in the list to see its report.
card.emptyAdd: No campaigns yet. ＋ Campaign creates a draft and opens it in the email builder.

when.active: Active · sends when a workflow step reaches someone
when.paused: Paused · workflow steps queue, nobody is sent

card.abPlanned: test on {percent} % by {metric} · decides {hours} h after sending starts
card.noReports: Figures of a colleague’s campaign need the right to see others’ reports.
card.noFigures: No figures yet: nobody has been sent this campaign.
card.untracked: Tracking was off for this campaign: opens and clicks were not recorded.
card.opensNote: Opens are approximate: mail clients that preload images are left out.
card.excludedCurrency: {n} subscriptions in another currency left out
card.canceled: Campaign canceled · duplicate it to change and schedule again
card.paused: Paused · nobody is sent until it is resumed

compare.title: Compare campaigns
compare.same: Same figures as each campaign’s report
compare.none: No sent campaign to compare yet.
compare.chosen: Your choice · both bars on the same 0–100 % scale
compare.defaultNote: The last six sent of the type shown · both bars on the same 0–100 % scale

recipients.title: Recipients · {name}
recipients.capped: The first 200 are shown; the export holds them all.

builder.chooseBody: Open a draft, or pick a layout under «Start from» to begin a new campaign.
builder.chooseBodyReadOnly: Open a campaign to see its design.
builder.noSelection: Row properties, subjects, audience and sender appear here when a campaign is open.
builder.testNotConnected: Test not sent: the email provider is not connected
builder.scheduled: Scheduled · the content is now fixed
builder.activated: Activated · workflow steps can now send it
builder.frozen: What was frozen when it was scheduled
builder.frozenBody: A scheduled or sent campaign keeps what it sends, for its report. Duplicate it to change it.
builder.deleteTemplateConfirm: Delete this template? Campaigns made from it keep their design.
builder.footerFixed: The footer is fixed: the sender’s name and postal address and the one-click unsubscribe link. Only its background changes.
builder.headerPlaceholder: Text beside the brand, e.g. the issue
builder.noUpload: Images are linked by address: uploading waits for the public host.
builder.linkItems: Items, one per line: Label | https://…
builder.htmlSanitized: Sanitised when saved: no scripts, forms, frames or styles.
builder.needsDomainAddress: Choose a sender domain with a postal address, and add that address
builder.htmlOk: The unsubscribe link and the sender’s postal address are present.

canvas.emptyTitle: Title — write it in the panel
canvas.emptyText: Text — write it in the panel
canvas.emptyList: List — one item per line in the panel
canvas.emptyItems: Links — add them in the panel
canvas.emptyHtml: HTML block — write it in the panel
canvas.noAddress: No postal address on the sender domain

footerStream.marketing: sent from the marketing stream, separate from notifications

fields.name: Name
fields.automatedAudience: Workflow step · add a campaign step in Automation
fields.domainAuthenticated: DNS records found · provider verification waits for the email provider
fields.domainUnchecked: DNS records not found yet: scheduling needs SPF, DKIM and DMARC
fields.noAbAutomated: Automated campaigns have no A/B test.
fields.couponsUnknown: The coupon list needs the right to see billing.

trackingRule.on: Tracking is on for every campaign (Settings › Rules).
trackingRule.off: Tracking is off for every campaign (Settings › Rules).

fields.notifyOwners: Notify owners when their people open or click
fields.layoutNote: A starting layout, shared with everyone.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.domainUnchecked: {domain}: the DNS check has not found SPF, DKIM and DMARC (the DNS check worker is not connected yet)
schedule.addressOk: The footer carries the sender’s postal address
schedule.addressMissing: The sender domain needs a postal address (Deliverability)
schedule.footerProblem: Your HTML needs the unsubscribe link and the postal address
schedule.footerOk: Your HTML carries the unsubscribe link and the postal address
schedule.abNeedsTracking: An A/B test needs tracking, which is off by rule
schedule.noProvider: No email provider is connected: at its time the campaign is held with that reason, and leaves once one is.
schedule.activateNote: Workflow steps with this campaign start sending to the people they reach.
schedule.frozenNote: Scheduling saves the draft and freezes what is sent; the report shows exactly that.

segment.title: Segment: {name}
segment.unsupported: This segment uses conditions the editor cannot show; its counts are still live.
segment.toggleJoin: Switch between AND and OR (OR joins this condition with the one above)
segment.noConditions: No conditions: everyone you may see.
segment.noneReceivable: Nobody here is subscribed with an address that is not suppressed.
segment.name: Name
segment.savedTitle: Saved segments · shared by sales and marketing
segment.clickedWithin: clicked in any campaign in {n} days

consent.doubleOptInOff: Newsletter signups subscribe at once (double opt-in off)
consent.oneList: one suppression list across all sends ({n})
consent.logged: every change logged with time and source

suppressions.title: Suppression list
suppressions.badSearch: Search by a full email address: the list keeps hashes only.
suppressions.note: An unsubscribe or a spam report is the person’s own decision and cannot be lifted here.

deliver.recheckQueued: DNS re-check queued for {n} domains · rows update when the check reports
deliver.noDomainsAdd: No sending domain yet. ＋ Domain adds one; its DNS records are checked when the check runs.
deliver.checksNote: SPF, DKIM and DMARC come from the DNS check; «Verified» from the email provider.
deliver.checksNoteNoProvider: SPF, DKIM and DMARC come from the DNS check, which has not run yet; «Verified» needs the email provider, which is not connected.
deliver.streamsBody: Campaigns send from {marketing} on the marketing stream; survey invitations use {transactional} on the transactional stream, so a campaign can never hurt invitation deliverability. Mail from staff mailboxes is a third path.

f.postalPlaceholder: Company AS, street, postcode and town
f.sendsHere: This platform sends from it (off for a domain another system sends from)
f.checkNote: The domain’s name is fixed once added; its DNS records are checked when the check runs.

rec.dnsMissing: Publish the {records} record for {domain} before the next send.
rec.dmarcNone: Set a DMARC policy (quarantine or reject) for {domain}; «none» only reports.
rec.bounce: The bounce rate of {domain} is {rate} over 30 days — above 3 %.
rec.hygiene: {n} contacts have not engaged in {months} months. Archive them to protect sender reputation (list hygiene).
rec.identityOk: Unsubscribe link and sender identity are present in all marketing templates.
rec.identityMissing: Add a postal address to {domains}: every footer prints it.

deliver.archiveConfirm: Archive {n} contacts? Their status becomes Archived, logged as list hygiene.
deliver.checksNoteNoProviderChecked: SPF, DKIM and DMARC come from the DNS check; «Verified» needs the email provider, which is not connected.
